_this-file: THE DECLARED SOURCE for the two things the per-meeting job cannot know from the bytes:
which display-name markers mean 'this artifact is auxiliary meeting notes rather than a
transcript', and which summarizer skill writes an entity's meetings. Both are owner values;
neither is ever typed into tools/per_meeting_job.py.
artifact-kinds: read by tools/artifact_reader.py ONLY when the artifact does not declare its
own type in frontmatter. Notes markers are tried before transcript markers.
skill-bindings: by-entity wins; 'default' is used only if declared. With neither, the job
REFUSES rather than picking a summarizer for the owner.
